comment: <TEACHER> is very flexible with deadlines and gives a lot of good feedback on assignments. If you are taking the class online make sure you show effort by attending office hours and going to the writing center when needed, she is the sweetest and genuinely wants to help you succeed.

title: Professor in the English department at University of Alabama at Birmingham
comment: <TEACHER> is awesome. You obviously have to write essays in the class like the others but theyre super easy and shes gives useful feedback. Shes also quick in responding to emails. We did discussion posts that require a little reading but its quick and easy. If you show that your putting in effort, youll get an A.

title: Professor in the English department at University of Alabama at Birmingham
comment: She grades you based off of how much effort you put into your assignment. There is usually a reading journal due each week and some weeks there is a writing assignment also due! Easy to manage with other classes, but as long as you time yourself and make sure your effort is shown, you are good! Use the writing center for feedback, she loves it!!

title: Professor in the English department at University of Alabama at Birmingham
comment: She's lenient on deadlines and finds a silver lining in everyone's work, she's very caring and helpful.

title: Professor in the English department at University of Alabama at Birmingham
comment: <TEACHER> is an awesome teacher and I highly recommend you take her class. She is so much fun in class and you can tell she really enjoys what she does. She is more than willing to help you if you're struggling and can be very lenient with deadlines if you email her and ask questions.

title: Professor in the English department at University of Alabama at Birmingham
comment: I would only recommend taking her if you really want to learn. She is very passionate about her work. She also cares about her students maybe more than the students care about themselves. You do have to attend class if not your grade will decrease after the 3rd absence. Its not a lot of papers to write but there is a lot of reading to do.

title: Professor in the English department at University of Alabama at Birmingham
comment: She's not bad at teaching however, if you miss class because of an emergency and there was a quiz. Good luck trying to take it. Also she will change how the quizzes are set up, randomly. Some days it will start at 8am - 8:10am day of. Other days it will open at 5pm and close at 8am next class but wont tell you. So if you miss it she won't help you.

title: Professor in the English department at University of Alabama at Birmingham
comment: <TEACHER> is a really amazing woman who really wants to make the class enjoyable. Shes very approachable. Get ready to read short readings every class and have discussions or write 1 page papers for them. 1 4 page paper about every 4 weeks or so. Generally easy class.

title: Professor in the English department at University of Alabama at Birmingham
comment: Easily one most nicest ladies and most awesome professors I've ever had! You have to do the work or else it will show and she will know it... but that really should go without saying. It's not too much work though so... you'll have an easy A as long as you're not lazy and do your part.

title: Professor in the English department at University of Alabama at Birmingham
comment: Took <TEACHER> my first semester in college and loved her. I specifically searched her out for my 102 class even though a different professor taught the class on days that would have been better. Class discussions are amazing and she has a one on one  connection with every student and really cares about helping you succeed.

title: Professor in the English department at University of Alabama at Birmingham
comment: She is definitely my favorite English teacher. She is very clear on what she expects and helps you when you still don't understand. She always has something new and exciting planned for every class! I really wish she taught other classes. She is really good at giving feedback so you know how to improve next time. I would recommend taking her class.

title: Professor in the English department at University of Alabama at Birmingham
comment: I love professor <TEACHER>. She is funny and has interesting lectures, and also leaves you room to be creative without being one of those teachers that give you no direction, I took her my first semester and loved her so much I took her again even though a different time would have been better for me.

title: Professor in the Textiles  Clothing department at Fashion Institute of Technology
comment: Would be nice one second and the next she would be yelling. criticizes your intelligence more then your work. Instead of helping me understand my mistakes, she would always likes to ask "how could you make this mistake?" without helping me fix my mistake. Overall really didn't like this teacher at all.

title: Professor in the Textiles  Clothing department at Fashion Institute of Technology
comment: Very tough, Clear, Helpful, Encouraging, overall you'll learn a lot!

title: Professor in the Medical Technology department at Ivy Tech Community College: Indianapolis
comment: <TEACHER> was an awesome professor! I wish I could have her for all of my classes! As long as you show up to the classes and study the material she went over in the lecture you're good to go. Very easy A! Tons of extra credit!

title: Professor in the Medical Technology department at Ivy Tech Community College: Indianapolis
comment: She will help you get through this class.  It is time consuming but easy to get an A as long as you put in some time on the work book.

title: Professor in the English department at California Baptist University
comment: She can be very understanding and isn't a tough grader IF you follow her guidelines. She gives out a lot of busy work like two reading logs per week and the papers just keep coming. You finish a paper and you are already starting on the next paper. It is not a terrible class if you can keep up with the workload.

title: Professor in the English department at California Baptist University
comment: If you just need English 123 as a GE requirement, take her.  Most of the major essays lead into the final paper topic, which YOU get to choose!  She is not a harsh grader, and if you are struggling, especially balancing your workload between classes, she WILL work with you.  You just have to ask.  However, there is a fair amount of busy work.

title: Professor in the English department at California Baptist University
comment: <TEACHER> is by far one of my favorites I have had here at CBU. She cares about her students so much and is always willing to help. She is easy to get in contact with and provides helpful feedback. Her class had many assignments each week however, they were manageable and she made it very clear what she expected from each assignment.

title: Professor in the English department at California Baptist University
comment: Fun and engaging professor--don't buy the textbook.

title: Professor in the English department at California Baptist University
comment: Obsessed with covid and requires masks all the time but it's pretty straightforward to take her class. I didn't even come half the time because she didn't do attendance. Take her for an easy A and be done with it all.

title: Professor in the English department at California Baptist University
comment: A lot of busy work and unnecessary assignments. 3 papers out of however many are able to be used again for your final paper. She does give good feedback so you can get a good score on your papers. She also responds very fast to emails. Masks are mandated even with the updated school policy.

title: Professor in the English department at California Baptist University
comment: The teacher is pretty nice and its pretty straightforward. She didnt require attendance because of COVID so i literally stopped showing up like halfway through and still passed. She assigns a lot of busy work (short readings, questionnaires, small papers) but she always gives an A. Pretty easy stuff.

title: Professor in the English department at California Baptist University
comment: <TEACHER> is the most caring professor I've had at CBU. The main focus of the class is the final research paper but you make steps towards it throughout the semester which helps. She is accessible through email. Most times she offered class time to work on her assignments. Also you have to wear your mask at all times which I didn't mind. No tests.

title: Professor in the English department at California Baptist University
comment: This is an easy class, however there is a lot of busy work. The Research Essay is a fun, whole semester project, but the reading logs and other assignments are tedious and get in the way of you other work. The professor is great tho, very kind and caring, but the coursework is sub-par.

title: Professor in the English department at California Baptist University
comment: <TEACHER> is a good professor who will give a lot of homework like freewrites, reading logs, and essays. However, they will all add up to your final paper in the class. She will help you as much as you can if you communicate with her well. She is accessible through emails and before and after classes. She will offer plenty of extra credits.

title: Professor in the English department at California Baptist University
comment: The best English Professor you can ever ask for ! She is not a harder grader and is understandable to when you are struggling shes always available through email and when you need office hours. The essays are not difficult as they are supposed to prepare you for your major/career. Dont stress yourself out and take <TEACHER>!

title: Professor in the English department at California Baptist University
comment: Prof. <TEACHER> is the best English teacher I have ever had in any education course! She genuinely cares about the student as an individual. She's mainly grades on completion, but she goes over the essays with a fine tooth comb. Nonetheless, she was a great professor for both freshman English classes. I will miss being in her class.

title: Professor in the English department at California Baptist University
comment: Very easy to pass the class, there are 5 essays and many free writes and usually watch movies to help with writing essays and gives great feedback on your essays to help you improve.

title: Professor in the English department at California Baptist University
comment: Prof. <TEACHER> is a fantastic teacher. She makes it clear that she doesn't want to be a strict teacher and will cooperate with your needs if you feel overwhelmed with her assignments or other things in life. She will put meaning into why you need to do this assignment and will try to make it realistic as possible.

title: Professor in the English department at California Baptist University
comment: Very homework heavy, but it's not busy work. We watch movies and play card games for class credit. She doesn't grade hard, except on essays, which are the exams. Definitely recommend taking again.

title: Professor in the English department at California Baptist University
comment: <TEACHER> is 1 of the best professors at CBU. She breaks down each assignment so that it is not overwhelming. She also has free-write assignments which are fun and make you think. this is an essay heavy class, but its a ENG123 requirement. She grades fairly and gives good feedback. She will let you fix an essay if it is really bad.

title: Professor in the English department at California Baptist University
comment: She was an amazing english teacher to take. There are no tests or quizzes. There were 5 really easy papers to write throughout the course. You won't be up all night trying to write these papers just as long as you do them you'll do fine. We watch a lot of movies and shows in class and a few papers are based off the movies we watch in class.

title: Professor in the English department at California Baptist University
comment: Good Professor. A lot of writing and reading but textbook is really good.

title: Professor in the English department at California Baptist University
comment: If you are triggered by furries, do not take her class. Other than that, great professor and easy grader!

title: Professor in the English department at California Baptist University
comment: <TEACHER> is an awesome professor over all. She is very understanding, and makes learning fun. I am taking English 1b with her, and I recommend her 100%.

title: Professor in the Computer Science department at University of Wisconsin - Stevens Point
comment: If you don't already know JQuery, PHP, and MySQL, do not take his course.  To put it bluntly, I learned more in an 8 minute JQuery video tutorial than I did in four weeks of his classes. Very nice person and is willing to help outside of class when you need it, but assignments and tests are not clear. Gets onto unrelated topics very easily.

title: Professor in the Engineering department at University of Delaware
comment: He was by far the best teacher I have ever had at Delaware. I was a Computer Engineering major until I switched to Computer Science but he made me want to continue with a minor. He was extremely enthusiastic during lectures and would make jokes in between. While he was a great teacher, don't expect to breeze through and pass.

title: Professor in the Engineering department at University of Delaware
comment: Pretty good professor, clear during lecture most of the time, some concepts can be "hairy" but definitely accepting of questions when needed. Lectures aren't mandatory, UDCapture available. If having any trouble in this course, GO TO OFFICE HOURS. They are VERY helpful and he seems to be better with small groups individuals.

title: Professor in the Engineering department at University of Delaware
comment: Really cool guy, his accent isn't hard to understand. The grading is forgiving but the exams aren't easy(thought I absolutely tanked my exam but got a c-).  Pretty hard to fail if you are putting forth any effort.

title: Professor in the Theater department at University of Wisconsin - Stevens Point
comment: Jenny is hilarious and flamboyant as a Theatre professor should be! random but easy 5 question pop quizzes so come to class! only 3 exams including the final. read 5 plays and take 6 question exams to make sure you read it  Don't buy the book for the plays. You can find them free online. you also have to see 2 performances on campus for credit.

title: Professor in the Theater department at University of Wisconsin - Stevens Point
comment: Amazing professor - would recommend her class to anyone with any interest in theater at all.  Very entertaining but still stays generally on topic with her lectures.  Lots of short videos to help remember content - class attendance not mandatory, just suggested.

title: Professor in the English department at Auburn University at Montgomery
comment: dr howard is a great communicator and loves to see students have fun in the class :) participation is very much needed in the class but its worth it

title: Professor in the English department at Auburn University at Montgomery
comment: Super nice and explains things really well. Assignments are creative and makes you think outside the box.

title: Professor in the English department at Auburn University at Montgomery
comment: I loved taking this English class. I usually don't like to write, but she made it fun and enjoyable to do. To get a good grade, all you have to do is show up to class, listen to her, and do the work she gives. Super easy and great class. I would definitely take it again.

title: Professor in the English department at Auburn University at Montgomery
comment: Absolutely loved this class. I typically don't enjoy english or writing assignments but she made the class very enjoyable overall. She didn't grade my papers super harshly I don't think, and she was very understanding.

title: Professor in the English department at Auburn University at Montgomery
comment: I absolutely loved her. Not a very harsh grader and is willing to work with you.

title: Professor in the English department at Auburn University at Montgomery
comment: I like her. She can be a bit intense, but it's because she cares and likes what she teaches. She's kind. You'll learn quite a bit with her.  Be sure you participate.

title: Professor in the English department at Auburn University at Montgomery
comment: I believe that she is the perfect professor to introduce you to writing. Be ready to write in class a lot. Lots of peer interaction and discussion. She makes everyone feel included; even introverts. There are quizzes on short readings from homework. She gets you used to writing more. She gives clear expectations and is available to help.

title: Professor in the English department at Auburn University at Montgomery
comment: <TEACHER> is the best teacher I  have ever had. I genuinely feel as if I have learned so much from her and that my writing skills have increased tremendously. She explains things very tactfully and gives great feedback on assignments. She is open to working with students. Not much reading involved. Four major essays. Overall, best teacher ever.

title: Professor in the English department at Auburn University at Montgomery
comment: I highly recommend taking her class. She's very laid back and lets you know everything that is expected of you. Participation is very important so you should never miss class. Be ready to write every day. There are a few reading assignments here and there as well as quizzes.

title: Professor in the English department at Auburn University at Montgomery
comment: Very helpful. Lots of reading, but what English class isn't. Keep up with readings and out of class assignments. Ask questions.

title: Professor in the English department at Auburn University at Montgomery
comment: Would take her again.

title: Professor in the English department at Auburn University at Montgomery
comment: I don't think she graded my papers harshly, and I was able to get an A on all of them except the final one. She is open to helping you if you ask for it, and she encourages in-class participation. She does care a lot about attendance though.

title: Professor in the Biology department at George Mason University
comment: He's a really nice professor and grades pretty easy on quizzes and tests, but his lectures are long and pointless. The lab could only take twenty minutes but he would ramble on for a good hour and a half.

title: Professor in the Biology department at George Mason University
comment: He is the nicest guy in the world. He also gives partial credit on the quizzes

title: Professor in the Biology department at George Mason University
comment: <TEACHER> is really nice but he keeps us in lab way longer than we need to be. He posts the powerpoints for lab the day before but then takes at least an hour and a half reading it word for word.  One time he took over an hour explaining that day's lab and I finished in 15 minutes. He's an easy grader but be prepared to be in lab for 3 hours.

title: Professor in the Biology department at George Mason University
comment: He's an easy grader, but you won't learn much from him. It can be hard to understand him because he has an accent. He spends nearly an hour talking about past experiments and talking about the experiment you're doing that day. He sends out slides about the experiment, but reads directly from the power points he makes during the lab itself.

title: Professor in the Psychology department at Aultman College of Nursing
comment: <TEACHER> is hands down one of the most helpful and knowledgable professors I have ever had. He makes great suggestions for improvement, and truly wants his students to learn and grow.

title: Professor in the Business department at Baker College of Auburn Hills
comment: Great professor really wants you to learn and will help wherever he can. I would take him for any class. There is some work and he is an APA stickler. But all in all great professor and knowledgeable.

title: Professor in the Psychology department at Illinois Central College
comment: She was a good person, and easy to talk to. However, I felt like we did not do a lot of learning during class. We never had homework or quizzes, which is nice, but then your grade determined on how you did on tests and final. She lets you use notes during tests. Easy going and a nice professor, just class felt like a waste of time somedays.

title: Professor in the Psychology department at Illinois Central College
comment: She let us use the book on our tests and quizzes. She was super nice in class and so flexible as long as you communicate with her! I highly recommend her class!

title: Professor in the Psychology department at Illinois Central College
comment: Tries to make lectures fun and get students involved. Tests are easy just take notes from her lectures and you'll pass. Overall I recommend

title: Professor in the Psychology department at Illinois Central College
comment: She was nice and willing to answer questions which I appreciated. All tests and the final are open note which sounds easy but most of the questions were scenario based which were extremely hard. She also never gave homework which sounds nice, but your tests and final determined your overall grade which I hated.

title: Professor in the Psychology department at Illinois Central College
comment: Overall a very easy class, tests are open note and the final is as well but there was a few tests I felt were not related to lecture at all so it was pretty frustrating but overall no homework and not a bad class.

title: Professor in the Psychology department at Illinois Central College
comment: Ms. Clark is a very nice person; however, her class was not a pleasant experience due to the lectures being random and unstructured, leading to the tests being overly difficult and not pertaining to powerpoint/lectures. Even when asking questions to the teacher, she didn't know the answer and would often say she'll have to look into it.

title: Professor in the Psychology department at Illinois Central College
comment: I love her! She has been my favorite teacher so far. Shes so down to earth and accepting of everyone. I love discussions in her class. She makes jokes and is (usually) funny. The grading is based on exams and an abstract. She offers extra credit. Highly recommend!

title: Professor in the Psychology department at Illinois Central College
comment: I have taken two classes with Prof. Clark and wish she taught more classes so I could take them with her! She really takes time to explain concepts to the class and checks to make sure students are correctly interpreting the course materials. She has been my favorite professor ever! She really cares for student- she gave some pointers for my resume

title: Professor in the Psychology department at Illinois Central College
comment: Dr. Clark is a helpful and caring professor and is very passionate about psychology. She gave us four multiple choice, forty question, open note exams and an open note, sixty multiple choice question exam. She is not a great lecturer, but read the chapters before class, take notes and then fill with what she lectures and you should be golden!

title: Professor in the Psychology department at Illinois Central College
comment: The only thing I didnt enjoy about this class is that the test were really the only thing we were graded on. If you had a bad test, it was hard to bring your overall grade back up. However she does allow you to use all notes on the tests and the final. Take thorough notes, you will be set!

title: Professor in the Psychology department at Illinois Central College
comment: <TEACHER> was a solid choice by far. Took her class during Christmas break minimester 2016. Best choice I made! Be ready to take lot's of notes, and listen to a week worth of lectures per day. Take really good notes, you'll use them to your advantage. Her quizzes could be annoying at times but not hard. Highly recommended!! You won't be sorry! ;)

title: Professor in the Psychology department at Illinois Central College
comment: Very nice lady but tends to go off on tangents that are not related to class. I struggled on these tests because I was not prepared and my notes were not very helpful. She does give daily one question quizzes and opportunities for extra credit which is nice.

title: Professor in the Psychology department at Illinois Central College
comment: The class was never boring, and you could use your notes on test which was helpful. There was also many opportunities for extra credit!
